mapper.select: SELECT a.alert_id, a.content_type, a.content_id, a.keyword_id, a.summary, a.created_at, k.keyword, u.username, u.user_id FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN keywords k ON a.keyword_id = k.keyword_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.post_id as id, p.user_id, 'POST' as type FROM posts p UNION ALL SELECT c.comment_id as id, c.user_id, 'COMMENT' as type FROM comments c ) content ON a.content_id = content.id AND a.content_type = content.type LEFT JOIN users u ON content.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.alert_id = #{alertId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alerts (content_type, content_id, keyword_id, summary, created_at) VALUES (#{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{keywordId}, #{summary}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE alerts SET summary = CONCAT(summary, ' [已处理]') WHERE alert_id = #{alertId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.alert_id, a.content_type, a.content_id, a.keyword_id, a.summary, a.created_at, k.keyword, CASE WHEN a.content_type = 'POST' THEN (SELECT u.username FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = a.content_id) WHEN a.content_type = 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT u.username FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = a.content_id) END as username, CASE WHEN a.content_type = 'POST' THEN (SELECT p.user_id FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = a.content_id) WHEN a.content_type = 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT c.user_id FROM comments c WHERE c.comment_id = a.content_id) END as user_id FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN keywords k ON a.keyword_id = k.keyword_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.alert_id, a.content_type, a.content_id, a.keyword_id, a.summary, a.created_at, k.keyword, CASE WHEN a.content_type = 'POST' THEN (SELECT u.username FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = a.content_id) WHEN a.content_type = 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT u.username FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = a.content_id) END as username, CASE WHEN a.content_type = 'POST' THEN (SELECT p.user_id FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = a.content_id) WHEN a.content_type = 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT c.user_id FROM comments c WHERE c.comment_id = a.content_id) END as user_id FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN keywords k ON a.keyword_id = k.keyword_id WHERE a.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
